title: Trail / Scavenger Hunt
shortDescription: A mobile-first adventure that guides visitors through playful, location-based challenges using their own devices. It turns spaces into an interactive trail of discovery, curiosity, and momentum.
longDescription: A gamified, mobile-led experience that leads participants through a series of clues, tasks, and locations. Visitors uncover hints, solve challenges, and progress step by step along a curated route. Each interaction reveals a new layer of the story, encourages exploration, and keeps engagement high. Designed to adapt to exhibitions, events, cities, or brands, it transforms movement into meaning and participation into a memorable journey.

highlights.title: A Start that you design
highlights.description: Set the tone before the first step. Open with a custom welcome screen in any language, then shape how players enter: add a privacy or consent checkbox for the legal step, assign each player a role or mission, or swap static instructions for a video onboarding. The entry point is yours to craft, playful, branded, or cinematic, so every trail feels like your own.

highlights.title: Mix Your Own Challenges
highlights.description: Build the journey from a flexible deck of challenge types and arrange them however your story flows. Mix multiple-choice and trivia for knowledge, 'guess the word' for puzzles, location-based check-ins for movement, or open creative prompts: take a photo, complete a dare, or interpret a task their own way. Tune the difficulty and tone so the mix fits your audience and your message.

highlights.title: Guide the Journey
highlights.description: Make sure no one ever feels lost. A visual timeline maps completed and upcoming challenges so players always know where they are, and on top of it you can layer a voice: a live moderator who nudges through real-time chat, or a pre-scripted bot that drops hints, cheers players on, and reveals the next clue with personality. Together they turn a checklist of tasks into a journey players feel guided through.

highlights.title: End on Your Terms
highlights.description: Decide how the journey lands. Close with a final 'moral' page that ties the story together, a recap of scores and stats, or a leaderboard reveal that crowns the winners. Reward completion with a real prize, or a unique QR code that unlocks a discount, a collectible, or the next chapter. The finale is where your trail leaves its mark, so make it count.

highlights.title: One Route, Any World
highlights.description: Reskin the same route engine for any world: a museum mystery that reveals facts along the way, a city heritage walk, a brand discovery tour, a kids' treasure hunt, or a festive advent trail. Look, story, and challenges all change while the underlying flow stays the same.

highlights.title: Optional Trail Data
highlights.description: Add a data layer to track starts, stop completion, drop-off points, time per challenge, and finish rate, and connect it to tokens or dashboards for post-event reporting that shows exactly where visitors went and what held their attention.

highlights.title: Part of a Bigger Journey
highlights.description: Pair it with Visitor Identificator to tie progress and identity to each visitor profile, with Journey Manager to make the trail one leg of a longer multi-stop route, or with a Shared Gallery to collect and showcase the photos players capture along the way.

states.trigger: Visitor scans the start QR code or opens the trail link.
states.experience: A short welcome flow loads on the phone, sets the language, and explains the goal before the first challenge.
states.feedback: Branded welcome screen, language picker, a clear start cue.
states.configurable: Welcome copy, languages, roles, consent step, onboarding video.

states.trigger: A challenge unlocks at a stop or location.
states.experience: A clue or task appears and the player solves it to move on, with difficulty able to ramp across the route.
states.feedback: Live timeline, progress bar, hints, success and retry cues.
states.configurable: Challenge types, order, difficulty, hint logic, time limits.
states.data: Attempts, time per challenge, hint use, accuracy.

states.experience: The score updates, the map advances, and the next clue is revealed, optionally with a moderator or bot message.
states.feedback: Success animation, points, map update, guiding voice.
states.configurable: Scoring, reveal logic, moderator or bot tone.
states.data: Completions per stop, running score, drop-off points.

states.trigger: The final challenge is completed or the route ends.
states.experience: A wrap-up recap, leaderboard, and any reward or unlock are presented.
states.feedback: Moral page, score card, leaderboard reveal, prize or QR unlock.
states.configurable: End page, reward logic, leaderboard, share prompt.
states.data: Finish rate, total time, rewards claimed, shares.
